status: Preregistered; not run; requires instrumentation absent from exposed API
restriction: Only existing allowed lab datasets; no identical completed-cell repeats or KB mutations.

tests.setting: Checkpoint at1024 on both existing polynomial splits; fork equal512-update continuations at.001 versus3e-5, same model/data/order/state. Measure train/test every32 updates.
tests.prediction: A reversible late-step precision floor predicts reduced training AND test residuals after downshift in stable seeds.
tests.falsifier: Downshift improves test only while training fit worsens, or fails to reduce train residual across stable paired branches; this weakens the proposed reversible precision explanation, not every optimization mechanism.

tests.setting: Export all original ten per-seed endpoints and trajectories first; measure finite flags, gradient/update norms and maximum train/test excursions.
tests.prediction: Tail-dominant instability predicts high-rate losses concentrate in poor seeds with train excursions; rate reduction rescues paired poor branches.
tests.falsifier: No train excursions or fit failures and a broad median test-only disadvantage; catastrophic-tail-only account fails if trimming the largest prespecified seed leaves the median disadvantage.

tests.setting: At matched checkpoint ages, compare paired full-train and fixed-test MSE; reserve a new allowed validation split for schedule selection if supported.
tests.prediction: Generalization-dominant reversal predicts high-rate equal/better train fit but worse test MSE and a growing gap.
tests.falsifier: High-rate poor seeds also have worse training MSE and downshift reduces both residuals without a larger gap.

tests.setting: At1024 fork2x2 low/high continuation rate x preserve/reset Adam moments and step counter. All branches keep weights and identical remaining batches.
tests.prediction: If retained optimizer state determines recovery, preservation and reset differ beyond initial transient; pure rate-floor account predicts both low-rate branches eventually improve fit.
tests.falsifier: No sustained state effect weakens state-memory dominance. Reset cannot be called pure beta2 intervention.

tests.setting: Future within-set new bs64 rate pairs at T512 and2048; compare with bs16 only in admissible joint design without repeating existing cells.
tests.prediction: Noise-floor hypothesis predicts smaller high/low disadvantage at larger batch; update-age hypothesis ties reversal more toT than exposure; exposure-only ties it more toT*bs/256.
tests.falsifier: No directional batch attenuation weakens noise-floor extension; disagreement of matched-exposure ordering rejects exposure-only invariance.
